title: ISC2 Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
releaseBlockers: trademark review of the ISC2 and CCSP names
ten concepts cite only the outline (tokenisation, DREAD, PASTA, ASVS, CASB and others): find open sources or drop them
NIST publications with non-NIST co-authors may not be public domain: check each one cited
description: CCSP: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: NIST publications and other open standards
notice: ISC2, CCSP and CBK are registered marks of ISC2, Inc. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by ISC2, Inc. It contains no ISC2 exam content and is not built from ISC2 study materials.

checks.what: Three independent audits read every card: those quoting NIST publications against their quotes, found word for word by the card checker, and those written in our own words (the ISC2 outline, OWASP, Microsoft Learn, GDPR, PIPEDA) against their sources
checks.result: 1 wrong card (how many cryptoperiod limits SP 800-57 lists) was fixed and rechecked; 21 unsupported claims, 3 ambiguous cards, 6 unclear ones and 39 minor issues were also fixed, and 2 duplicates removed.
